name: What is the average cost of a kitchen addition in the Los Angeles area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of a kitchen addition in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen addition in the Los Angeles area can vary significantly due to factors like size, materials, finishes, and complexity of structural work. While a basic addition might start around $100,000, luxury kitchen additions with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and extensive architectural features can easily exceed $300,000. It's best to consult with a builder for a detailed estimate tailored to your specific design goals and property conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Los Angeles, kitchen additions can range from $100,000 to over $300,000, depending on size, materials, and custom features.
